findings.title: P 值极端偏小，提示细胞级伪重复嫌疑 (P-value inflation heuristic)
findings.impact_on_conclusion: 检测到 18 个基因的 p 值低于 1e-100（最小 p=1.8571412410296082e-200）。这只能作为细胞级检验的疑点，不能仅凭数值把正确的供体级检验判为伪重复。
findings.minimal_fix:
# 核查统计单位，而不是仅因 p 值很小就否定供体级结果：
# 1. 确认检验是否按 donor 聚合；
# 2. 若确为 cell-level Wilcoxon/t-test，改用供体级 Pseudobulk + PyDESeq2。

findings.title: 科学声明超出证据边界 (Claim Exceeds Evidence Ceiling)
findings.impact_on_conclusion: 用户提交的具体声明 'IL1RN is significantly downregulated after FDR correction in the supplied treated-versus-control result.' 断言了超出当前证据上限的结论 （请求类别: causal，证据上限: FRAGILE）。缺失关键证据: missing_causal_identification。
findings.claim_affected: IL1RN is significantly downregulated after FDR correction in the supplied treated-versus-control result.
findings.minimal_fix: 修改文稿声明，仅陈述为已观察到的转录组差异表达关联，不得在无扰动实验或临床金标准时断言因果靶点。

claim_boundary.recommended_methods_text: Recommended analysis, not recorded as performed: aggregate raw integer counts to donor-level pseudobulks per cell type (Squair et al., 2021), then test condition effects with a negative binomial GLM, Wald tests, and Benjamini-Hochberg FDR.
